smoke.line: A column of smoke or steam rises in the distance, thin and straight.
A faint smell of burning old bedrock drifts from somewhere north.

footprints.line: A thread of footprints, not yours, crosses your path and trails off.
Boot impressions press deep into the dirt, heading toward the rise.

obelisk.line: A toppled obelisk lies on its side, runes faded but not yet silent.
A standing stone juts from the mud, its face cut with old old glyphs.

wagon.line: A wagon, abandoned and broken-axled, leans into the mud ahead.

arch.line: You spot what looks like a stone arch, half-swallowed by old mud.

glint.line: A glint of metal — too small to name yet — lies in the rubble.

handprint.line: A handprint pressed into old bedrock dust, recent enough to still hold shape.

thread.line: A thread of cold air leaks from somewhere behind the rubble.

resonance.line: A faint resonance pulses from the south. Something there is awake.
The strange haze thickens around one specific spot. You cannot tell why.

half_buried_spire.line: Half an old spire juts from the mud like the bone of a long-dead beast, the top three storeys still defiant.
A buried dome's apex breaks the surface ahead, glass-glazed and humming faintly.

etheric_storm.line: The horizon cracks — blue and purple lightning, an charged storm walking on long legs across the plain.
Static gathers in your hair. The strangeness is about to break weather on this ridge.

pulsing_mud.line: A patch of mud just off the path pulses with a faint blue glow, in time with nothing you can hear.

frozen_statue.line: A figure stands ahead, perfectly still — until you realise the hardened glass froze them mid-step, generations ago.

sentinel_patrol.line: Far to the east, a patrol construct paces a ruined wall — patrol pattern, by the book, never deviating.

mud_golem_stir.line: The mud over there is bulging in a way mud does not bulge unaided. Something is reforming itself.

temporal_eddy.line: For a half-second the light shifts — sunset, then dawn, then now. A temporal eddy, the kind scavengers warn about.

spatial_warp.line: The way you came is not where it should be. The landscape has folded slightly while your back was turned.

whisper_crystal.line: A crystal embedded in a half-broken pillar whispers — actual words, almost — when you pass within arm's reach.

black_cloak.line: Someone in a long black coat is two ridges back, matching your pace. They have been there for a while.

giant_silhouette.line: On the far ridge — for the space of a held breath — a figure too tall to be human watches you. Then it isn't there.

bioluminescent_path.line: A line of pale-blue fungus blooms across the ground ahead — the first walkers grow this where they walk often.

wreck_construct.line: An strange construct lies half-toppled in the mud, one arm still flexing weakly, its core dim but unbroken.

submerged_steeple.line: The top of a flooded old cathedral pierces the standing water ahead — steeple intact, the rest drowned.

black_market_lantern.line: A green lantern hangs at the mouth of a culvert — the marsh-folk mark their hidden markets with that exact green.

aether_grid_hum.line: Under your boots the ground hums steadily — an old strange grid line, still alive, running east.

sealed_vault_door.line: A circular old vault door, mud-pasted but intact, lies recessed into the slope. The locking glyphs are dim — but not gone.

preserved_corpse.line: An old body lies in the dirt, the hardened glass having frozen them at the moment they fell — robes still pristine, satchel still buckled.

loose_floorboard.line: One floorboard sits proud of the rest, its nails backed half out — lifted and re-laid more than once.

hidden_compartment.line: The wainscoting has a seam where there should be none — a panel, cut to the size of a hand.

watching_portrait.line: A portrait hangs crooked on the wall. The painted eyes have been scratched out — recently, the bare canvas beneath still pale.

bricked_doorway.line: A doorway in the far wall has been bricked up, the mortar still pale. Whatever room it led to, someone wanted it shut.

bloodstain_rug.line: A rug lies dead-centre on the floor — wrong for the room. The boards along its edge are dark with something old that soaked in.

open_ledger.line: A ledger lies open on the table, a column of names half of them struck through. The ink on the last entry is not yet dry.

childs_drawing.line: A child's drawing is pinned to the wall — a tall figure, all angles, standing over small stick people. Crayon, but the proportions are exact.

stopped_clock.line: A clock on the mantel has stopped — not wound down, stopped, hands frozen at a single minute as if the moment itself jammed.

scratched_door.line: The inside of the door is raked with scratch marks — fingernails, low down, frantic. Someone was shut in here and did not want to be.

warm_chair.line: The hearth is cold but swept clean, and a single chair faces it, angled as if someone just rose. The seat is still warm.

crooked_shelf.line: One shelf of books doesn't match the others — same spines, no dust, and they don't quite sit flush against the wall.

ceiling_drip.line: Water beads and falls from one spot in the ceiling, steady, though no storm has touched this place in years. Above is meant to be sealed.

bolted_strongbox.line: A strongbox sits bolted to the floor in the corner, its lock an old tumbler — dim, but not dead.

aether_tang.line: The air in this room tastes of the strangeness — sharp, metallic, the way it does near a working core. Nothing here should hum, and yet.

barefoot_prints.line: A set of footprints crosses the dust on the floor — small, bare — and they stop dead in the middle of the room. They do not come back.
